check_value: Every expense document in the file (invoice, receipt, payslip or allowance receipt) charged to AEXCID bears the AEXCID funding stamp, and the stamp shows all four items: (1) the project file number (expediente; expected: {project.file_number|any file number}); (2) the caption 'funded by AEXCID-Junta de Extremadura' in any language; (3) the percentage charged to AEXCID, written even when it is 100%; (4) the amount charged to AEXCID, which equals that percentage of the document total and does not exceed it. Fails if the stamp is missing on any expense document or any of the four items is blank, illegible or inconsistent with the total.
agent_hint: Find the AEXCID rubber stamp (usually near the total or the signature). Check the four items one by one and name the missing one.
error_message: Sello AEXCID ausente o incompleto: debe indicar nº de expediente, la leyenda de financiación AEXCID-Junta de Extremadura, el porcentaje y el importe imputados (también cuando es 100%).

check_value: Proof of payment for this expense is attached and fits the payment method: (a) cash: the invoice or a receipt is signed or stamped by the supplier with the payment date and a mention such as 'payé', 'reçu', 'acquitté', 'pour acquit', 'cash', 'paid' or 'received'; (b) cheque: a copy of the cheque made out to the supplier plus the bank statement showing it was debited; (c) bank transfer: the bank statement or transfer confirmation showing the debit. The amount paid matches the invoice total. The method stated on the invoice matches the evidence (an invoice stating payment by transfer or cheque is not proven by a cash note). If one payment (cheque, transfer or cash advance) covers several invoices, a breakdown showing this invoice's amount within that payment is attached. Fails if proof is missing, does not fit the method or amount, or a combined payment has no breakdown.
agent_hint: Identify the payment method first (invoice wording, cheque, bank document, receipt), then check the evidence that method requires. Name the page_num of each proof.
error_message: Falta justificante de pago conforme al medio de pago (efectivo: recibí firmado por el proveedor; cheque: copia del cheque y extracto bancario; transferencia: extracto bancario), no coincide con el importe o falta el desglose de un pago conjunto.

check_value: Arithmetic is correct on every invoice and receipt in the file: for each line, quantity × unit price equals the line total; the line totals add up to the stated total (after any discount, tax or deposit shown); and where the total is also written in words (e.g. 'Arrêtée la présente facture à la somme de ...'), the amount in words equals the amount in figures. Ignore differences of 1 currency unit or less. When it fails, name the line and both values.
agent_hint: Recompute every line yourself instead of trusting the printed line totals. Convert the amount in words to a number before comparing.
error_message: Error aritmético en la factura (cantidad × precio unitario, suma de líneas o importe en letras distinto del importe en cifras): solicitar factura rectificativa.

check_value: Each invoice identifies the supplier with: business or person name, an address (street, district or town), and a tax identification number (NIF) or a company/trade register number (RCCM or equivalent). Fails if the name or address is missing, or if both the tax ID and the register number are missing. A receipt from an informal-market supplier with no invoice obligation passes if it shows the supplier's name and signature.
agent_hint: Look in the letterhead, header and footer for NIF, RCCM, N° contribuable or registre du commerce.
error_message: Datos del proveedor incompletos: faltan NIF y número de registro mercantil (RCCM), o el nombre o la dirección.

check_value: Each invoice is made out to the beneficiary organisation, a consortium partner or the local partner, written with its full legal name (accepted names: {project.payer_legal_names|not configured; any full legal name of the organisation}). Fails if the client is missing, is a private person, or is only an acronym or short name instead of the full legal name.
agent_hint: Read the 'Client', 'Doit', 'Facturé à' or 'Bill to' field.
error_message: La factura no identifica al pagador (entidad beneficiaria, socio del consorcio o socio local) con su denominación legal completa.

check_value: Each invoice states its tax treatment: a VAT/TVA or equivalent local tax amount, or an explicit statement that tax is included ('TTC', 'TVA incluse', 'VAT included', 'IVA incluido'), or a stated exemption or non-liability (e.g. 'exonéré', 'non assujetti', 'TVA non applicable', reference to an exemption or simplified tax regime). Fails if the invoice shows amounts excluding tax ('HT', 'hors taxes') with no tax line, no 'tax included' statement and no exemption. A receipt from an informal-market supplier with no invoice obligation passes.
agent_hint: Look at the totals block and the footer. 'HT' alone, without a tax line, 'TTC' or an exemption, is a failure.
error_message: No consta el tratamiento fiscal de la factura (importe de IVA o impuesto local, 'IVA incluido' o exención); p. ej. factura en 'HT' sin impuesto ni exención.

check_value: Supporting documents in the file (funds or purchase request, pro forma or quote, purchase order, delivery note, payment voucher, cheque, discharge/décharge) agree with the invoice in amount, quantity, item description and period, and their dates follow a plausible order: request, quote and order on or before the invoice date; payment on or after the invoice date unless the invoice states it was an advance payment. Fails on any contradiction between documents (e.g. a quote for a different quantity, an order for different items, a discharge for a different month, a request dated after the payment). Passes if the invoice has no supporting documents.
agent_hint: List each supporting page with its date, amount and quantity, then compare with the invoice. Name the page_num of any contradiction.
error_message: La documentación de soporte (solicitud, proforma, pedido, pago, descargo) no coincide con la factura en importe, cantidad, descripción o periodo, o las fechas no siguen un orden lógico.

check_value: All pages relate to the same expense (same supplier or payee, amount, date and purpose). Fails if (a) a page belongs to a different expense (different amount, supplier, payee or date with no link to this one), or (b) the file contains several invoices or receipts, from different suppliers or for different amounts, without a settlement statement that lists each one and reconciles them to the total paid (e.g. the settlement of a cash advance). Name the page_num of each unrelated page.
agent_hint: Compare amount, supplier and date on every page with the main document. Several receipts are fine only with a statement that adds them up.
error_message: El expediente contiene páginas de otro gasto, o varias facturas/recibos sin una liquidación que los relacione con el pago.

check_value: The document date (invoice or receipt issue date, or the pay period for payroll and allowances) is between {project.start_date} and {project.end_date} inclusive, and any payment date shown is on or after {project.start_date}. Fails if a date is outside this window; state the date found.
agent_hint: Use the issue date of the invoice or receipt, or the period paid for payroll and allowances.
error_message: La fecha del documento está fuera del periodo de ejecución del proyecto.

check_value: The invoice describes the service precisely: the tasks carried out, the time spent or duration (or estimated time), and the rate or unit price (AEXCID A.7). Repair, maintenance or washing of a vehicle names the vehicle (plate number); work on a generator or installation names the equipment or site. Fails for vague descriptions such as 'réparation' or 'prestation' with no detail.
agent_hint: Quote the description you read. Missing plate numbers on vehicle costs are a failure.
error_message: La descripción del gasto es insuficiente para justificarlo (faltan detalle, vehículo/matrícula, equipo o actividad, o en servicios las tareas, duración y tarifa).

check_value: A service contract, engagement letter, work order or accepted quote for the service is attached (AEXCID A.7). Fails if no document shows the service was commissioned.
agent_hint: Look for 'contrat', 'bon de commande', 'ordre de service', 'devis accepté'.
error_message: Falta el contrato de servicio o documento de encargo (orden de trabajo, presupuesto aceptado).

check_value: The expense belongs under AEXCID line A.7 Technical and professional services: services, technical assistance or consultancy for project activities, including repair and maintenance of equipment and vehicles. Fails if it is mainly goods (A.4), routine office running costs such as communications, electricity or rent (A.8), or travel and fuel (A.6).
agent_hint: Judge only what the documents show; there is no approved budget to compare against.
error_message: Revisar la imputación: el contenido del gasto no corresponde a la definición de la partida presupuestaria AEXCID.

check_value: If this purchase of supplies, equipment or services exceeds {eur:compliance.three_quotes_supplies_eur}, at least three quotes from different suppliers (or a documented justification that there are not enough suppliers) are attached. Contracts must not be split to stay under the threshold. Passes when the amount is below the threshold.
agent_hint: Compare the invoice total with the threshold in the same currency, then look for quotes or a bid summary.
error_message: Importe superior al umbral de contratación sin tres presupuestos de proveedores distintos.

check_value: The expense is not a non-eligible cost: promotion of the organisation itself or its partners, bank or debit interest, fines, penalties, surcharges or late-payment charges, legal or court costs, protocol or hospitality expenses (gifts, flowers, decorations, receptions, meals with guests, show tickets), severance pay, or depreciation of previously bought assets. agent_hint: Read every line item and flag only clearly non-eligible items.
error_message: El documento incluye gastos no subvencionables (promoción propia, intereses, multas o recargos, costas judiciales, gastos de protocolo, indemnizaciones o amortizaciones).
